Mask low-quality, under-observed and gas-flare pixels

Source: R/mask.R
ntl_mask.Rd

Applies explicit, recorded masking rules to a raster returned by ntl_read() or ntl_read_bm(). Every pixel that had a value but was removed is marked in an extra masked layer, so ntl_aggregate() can report the share of each unit lost to masking.

Usage

ntl_mask(x, quality_max = 1, min_obs = NULL, flares = NULL, cap = NULL)

Arguments

x

A SpatRaster with a value layer and optionally nobs and quality layers.

quality_max

Keep pixels with quality <= quality_max. NULL disables the rule. Ignored if there is no quality layer.

min_obs

Keep pixels with at least this many cloud-free observations. NULL disables the rule. Ignored if there is no nobs layer.

flares

Optional gas-flare mask: an sf/SpatVector of polygons or a SpatRaster whose non-zero cells are flares. Pixels touching a flare polygon are removed.

cap

Optional upper bound; values above it are set to cap (top-coding of extreme outliers, applied after masking).

Value

x with masked pixels set to NA in value and an added masked layer (1 = removed by a rule, 0 = kept, NA = no data).

Details

Black Marble monthly and annual quality flags are: 0 good (more than three observations), 1 poor (three or fewer observations), 2 gap-filled from earlier data. The default quality_max = 1 drops gap-filled pixels: they carry past values forward and would bias estimated effects toward zero.

Pixels with zero cloud-free observations (nobs == 0) are always treated as unobserved, whatever their stored value: EOG monthly composites store 0 radiance there, which would otherwise be read as "dark". They lower share_valid but are not counted as masked.

Examples

ex <- ntl_example()
m <- ntl_files(ex$dir, "eog_vnl_monthly")
r <- ntl_read(m, period = "2022-06", series = "eog_vnl_monthly_npp")
rm <- ntl_mask(r, min_obs = 2)
terra::global(rm$masked, "sum", na.rm = TRUE)
#>        sum
#> masked   0
